title: Veterans Pension Payment Schedule, Account Changes and Returned Payments
content:
# Veterans Pension payments: schedule, account changes, returned payments and death

**When pension is paid.** Veterans Pension is paid monthly in arrears on the product's payment day of the following month, moved to the last preceding business day when that day falls on a weekend or federal holiday. Payment of a new award begins with the month after the month of the effective date.

**Account changes.** An account change applies to a payment only when recorded at least the product's direct deposit lead time in calendar days before its issue date, and only the veteran can make it after the caller's identity is verified.

**Returned payments and unknown whereabouts.** An award is suspended when the product's returned-payment count or more payments come back within its rolling returned-payment window of months — counted as the returned payments whose payment date falls in that many calendar months ending on the current date — or when the veteran's whereabouts are unknown. It resumes once a current address or account is confirmed, with the withheld months released in one retroactive payment.

**Death of the veteran.** The payment for the month of the veteran's death is released to the surviving spouse; payments for later months are reclaimed.

## Condition — result

| Condition | Result |
|---|---|
| Account change recorded at least the lead time before the issue date, by the veteran after identity verification | applies to that payment |
| Account change recorded later than that | does not apply to that payment |
| Returned payments in the window reach the count | award suspended |
| Whereabouts unknown | award suspended |
| Suspended award, current address or account confirmed | award resumes; withheld months released in one retroactive payment |
| Month of the veteran's death | payment released to the surviving spouse |
| Months after the month of death | payments reclaimed |

## Illustration (hypothetical, using the product figures of the 1st, 10 days, 2 returns and 12 months)

A veteran's award has payments returned in February and in September of the same year, both inside the 12-month window ending today: the count of 2 is reached and the award is suspended. When the veteran confirms a current account, the award resumes and the months withheld while it was suspended are released together in one retroactive payment.
